text.aria-label: Subtitle text 'Mean over the cases that every arm holds. Control member of the ECMWF ensemble only, 13 Primary substations, 274 daily forecast runs from July 2023 to March 2024 (fold B). Scores are control-only and are not comparable with 51-member scores. Dot: mean. Line: 95% interval from re-drawing whole 4-week blocks of forecast start.'
